names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 decembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Levchie», with the rank words left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος, Κορωνάτος και η συνοδεία τους», which names the three together; the rank word is left off. The page glosses the name from the Latin lux, lucis, light: the bright, the shining one.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 14. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученици Тирс, Левкије и Калиник.“ — with «Свети мученици» left off and the second of the three bare forenames taken; the Caesarea of the display name is in the body. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

attestations.note: The Romanian row is 14 decembrie, the day doxologia prints this company's life. The Russian row on this folder is 17 August, and Thyrsus's Romanian row sits on 17 august, taken from a bare calendar line there; so the company renders on two Romanian days until that is settled. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος, Κορωνάτος και η συνοδεία τους»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The Russian rows already keep the three on this menologion day and the Greek calendar keeps them on the revised-julian 17 August, under the same three names and with their company, «και η συνοδεία τους». The notice is two sentences and both are about the record rather than the passion. **The first is a hedge of the page's own: «Ίσως να συγχέονται με αυτούς της 14ης Δεκεμβρίου και το όνομα Καλλίνικος του τρίτου μάρτυρα να έγινε Κορωνάτος» — perhaps they are confused with those of 14 December, and the name Callinicus of the third martyr became Coronatus. The corpus keeps both a Coronatus and a `callinicus-of-caesarea` in this company, so the hedge is recorded here and in the reader's report and nothing is merged on it.** The second is the one positive thing: «Πάντως γι' αυτούς τους τρεις αναφέρεται ότι «τελείται αυτών η σύναξις πλησίον των Ελενιανών»» — of these three it is said that their synaxis is held near the Helenianai. The page gives no year and no emperor, so the folder's 249–251 from the Sretensky calendar stands. **A second and separate Coronatus stands on the Greek 13 Αυγούστου, «Άγιος Κορωνάτος», whose whole notice is that he was martyred by the sword; that is another day and another entry, and by the settled rule two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so it is drafted as its own folder, `coronatus-13-august`, and the question is in the reader's report.** No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints a single distich for the three and no apolytikion and no kontakion, so no hymn is added.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 27.12.2025 (14. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Тирс, Левкије и Калиник.“

attestations.note: The second name of the day’s enumerated three; the heading is quoted whole on each of the three folders; URL year 2025. The day is the Romanian calendar’s own for him, where the Russian and Greek rows on this folder are 17 August. `types` UNTOUCHED: «мученици» is the `martyr` held. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the 249–251 is days.pravoslavie.ru’s and this book names the emperor «Кумврикије», Decius’s successor, with no year, which is consistent with that interval and narrows nothing. NO `locations`: Caesarea in Bithynia is named and the folder has never held a coordinate. NO `related` ROW ADDED: Thyrsus, Callinicus and `cornutus-of-iconium` are already here. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: that he was an honourable citizen of Caesarea in Bithynia and ALREADY BAPTISED where Thyrsus was still a catechumen; that he went before the emperor of his own accord and convicted him with a question — „Зашто си сам на своју душу заратио, о Кумврикије?“, why have you made war on your own soul, Koumvrikios? — and that after being beaten and tortured HE WENT TO HIS BEHEADING AS GLADLY AS TO A WEDDING. It is his death that the entry makes the cause of Thyrsus’s confession. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Tirs, Levchie, Calinic, Filimon, Apolonie și Arian (a common of martyrs, printed once for the six together; «nesctricăciunii» is the page's own reading)

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received from you, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having your strength they overthrew the tormentors, and broke also the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.
